spec.query:
SELECT
  "time",
  "stage"::tag AS "stage",
  "mode"::tag AS "mode",
  "accepted_maker_side" AS "maker_side",

  "market_tickers",
  "yes_price_post_fill",
  "contracts_fp_post_fill",
  "fill_size_usd",

  "expected_pnl_mid_maker_yes_pre_fill",
  "expected_pnl_mid_maker_no_pre_fill",
  "expected_pnl_mid_quote_accepted",
  "expected_pnl_mid_post_fill",
  "expected_pnl_mid_quote_accepted" - "expected_pnl_mid_post_fill" AS "pnl_accept_to_fill_slip",
  "expected_pnl_mid_30000ms",
  "alive" as "count",
  ("fill_rcvd_unix_time_ns" - "quote_accepted_rcvd_unix_time_ns") / 1000000000 AS "accept_to_fill_s",
  "yes_bid_pre_fill",
  "yes_ask_pre_fill",
  "yes_bid_quote_accepted",
  "yes_ask_quote_accepted",
  "combo_fair_yes_ask_quote_accepted",
  "combo_fair_yes_bid_quote_accepted",
  "yes_bid_post_fill",
  "yes_ask_post_fill",
  "pre_fill_unix_time_ns",
  "contracts_fp_self_match_post_fill",
  "market_ticker",
  "lot_size_usd_accepted",
  "quote_accepted_rcvd_unix_time_ns",
  "fill_rcvd_unix_time_ns",
  "order_id",
  "creator_id",
  "is_timeout"::tag AS "is_timeout",
  "is_cancel"::tag AS "is_cancel",
  "is_user_order_cancel"::tag AS "is_user_order_cancel",
  "contracts_fp_accepted",
  "contracts_fp_maker_yes_pre_fill",
  "contracts_fp_maker_no_pre_fill"
FROM "kalshi_strategy_rfq_trades"
WHERE
  ("mode" =~ /^$mode$/ AND "stage"::tag =~ /^$stage$/ AND "is_cancel"::tag = 'false' AND "is_timeout"::tag = 'false' AND "is_user_order_cancel"::tag != 'true')
  AND $timeFilter

SELECT cumulative_sum(sum("realized_pnl_delta_usd")) AS "Realized Pnl" FROM "default_defi_retention"."kalshi_mve_market_position" WHERE ("stage"::tag =~ /^$stage$/ AND "mode"::tag =~ /^$mode$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($interval) fill(0)

params: Approximate Realized PnL (doesn't work when strategy is off)

spec.query:
SELECT cumulative_sum(difference(mean("balance_usd"))) AS "Balance Delta Cumsum"
FROM "default_defi_retention"."kalshi_strategy_rest_balances"
WHERE ("stage"::tag =~ /^$stage$/ AND "mode"::tag =~ /^$mode$/) AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY time($interval) fill(previous)

SELECT cumulative_sum(difference(mean("open_position_value_usd"))) AS "Open Position Value Delta Cumsum"
FROM "default_defi_retention"."kalshi_strategy_rest_balances"
WHERE ("stage"::tag =~ /^$stage$/ AND "mode"::tag =~ /^$mode$/) AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY time($interval) fill(previous)

SELECT cumulative_sum(sum("fill_size_usd")) AS "Volumed Filled USD", cumulative_sum(sum("expected_pnl_mid_post_fill")) AS "Expected Pnl Mid Post Fill", cumulative_sum(sum("expected_pnl_mid_quote_accepted")) AS "Expected Pnl Mid Quote Accepted", cumulative_sum(sum("expected_pnl_mid_30000ms")) AS "Expected Pnl Mid Markout 30s", cumulative_sum(sum("lot_size_usd_accepted")) AS "Volume quote accepted USD" FROM "default_defi_retention"."kalshi_strategy_rfq_trades" WHERE ("stage"::tag =~ /^$stage$/ AND "mode"::tag =~ /^$mode$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($interval) fill(0)

options.alias: Realised + Unrealised PNL (doesn't work when we size up/down)

  "market_tickers",

  "market_ticker",
  "yes_settlement_value_dollars",
  "yes_ask_pre_fill",
  "yes_bid_pre_fill",

  ("mode" =~ /^$mode$/ AND "stage"::tag =~ /^$stage$/)
